name: 17-high-pay-old-regime
why: The same pay and history under the old regime. By hand: income 2,378,400; less 50,000 standard deduction, 2,400 professional tax (1,200 so far + 6 x 200) and 21,600 PF under 80C = 2,304,400; slabs 12,500 + 100,000 + 30% of 1,304,400 (391,320) = 503,820; with 4% cess 523,972.80, which the engine rounds to the whole rupee, 523,973. 261,986 is already deducted, so 261,987 over the 6 months left is 43,664.50, rounded to 43,665 a month. Open question for the consultant: whether annual tax is rounded to the rupee, as here, or to the nearest ten rupees.
